visible.message:
After clicking a button that calls st.rerun(), radios that appear after the button return their default values although the UI still shows my selections. Code:

radio_value = st.radio('Select1', ['Egg', 'Spam', 'Bacon'])
if st.button('Rerun'):
    st.rerun()
radio_value = st.radio('Select2', ['Egg', 'Spam', 'Bacon'])
st.write(radio_value)

I am on Streamlit 1.60.0.

agent_script.user_draft: Streamlit 1.64.0 fixed this: widgets after st.rerun keep the values the user selected instead of resetting to their defaults. Upgrade from 1.60.0 to 1.64.0 or later.

evidence_links.claim: 1.64.0: widgets after st.rerun keep the user's values.

decision_conditions.answer: Name the 1.64.0 fix and recommend upgrading. Native index: the registered passages must be in this turn's supplied bundle AND support the stated claim, its API scope and the active USER version; presence alone is not support.
decision_conditions.escalate: Under the native index, escalation is acceptable only when the registered passages were not supplied in this turn or do not cover the claim and version: it must name the missing documentation and a concrete next step, and still keep any supported guidance. When the passages were supplied and cover the case, escalation is unnecessary abstention.
